# 3d-disc-timeline

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Rimmed bevelled discs on a track, ribbon or S-curve. Backdrop: Light studio, ghosted world map. Items: 4 to 8. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Family item colours on the disc rims and on the track segment leading to each disc
- Track: mid grey #9AA3AE with a darker underside, or a rainbow gradient that shifts hue at each disc
- Light studio backdrop; ghosted world map or fine dot grid at 5 percent opacity is optional

## Visual elements

- Discs are bevelled, 3 to 4 percent rim thickness, white glossy face plate with a top-left highlight and a soft shadow underneath
- One flat icon per disc face, in the rim colour
- Numerals: large bold 01 over small caps STEP either on the face plate or beside the disc
- Track passes behind the discs, never through the face plate
- Dotted or thin leader lines with dot terminals link discs to text blocks
- Serpentine variant: ribbon width equals disc diameter, alternating left-right curves

## Typography

- Family typography; year or step label directly under the disc, name in bold caps, description in light charcoal

## Composition rules

- Straight track: landscape, five to eight discs, labels alternate above and below
- Chain track and serpentine: portrait, four to six discs, text alternates left and right
- Disc diameter 8 to 12 percent of the shorter canvas side; keep spacing even
- Every disc must have a distinct rim colour from its neighbours

## Layout

### Structure

- Track passing behind a row of discs
- One disc per node; rim colour is the item, face icon or numeral is the topic
- Track segment leading to each disc takes that disc's colour
- Period or step label directly under each disc
- Text blocks alternate sides of the track
- Optional zone bands above the track grouping nodes into phases

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Straight track** | Timelines, roadmaps | Landscape, five to eight discs, labels above and below |
| **Chain track** | Numbered procedures | Portrait, thick grey 3D track snaking down |
| **S-curve or serpentine** | Winding journeys | Ribbon width equals disc diameter, alternating curves |

### Visual Elements

- Discs bevelled, 3 to 4 percent rim thickness, glossy white face plate
- Top-left highlight and soft shadow under each disc
- Track with a darker underside, never crossing a face plate
- Thin or dotted leader lines with dot terminals
- Distinct rim colour on every neighbouring disc

### Text Placement

- Title at top
- Period or step label under each disc in a small panel
- Station heading and points above or below the track, alternating
- Disc diameter 8 to 12 percent of the shorter canvas side, even spacing
- Zone band labels inside the bands

## Prompt fragment

```

Large bold step numerals over small caps words, thin dotted leader lines with dot terminals to labels that alternate sides. Light off-white to grey studio backdrop with an optional ghosted world map or dot grid, soft offset shadows, top-left highlights. Rim colours cycle through teal, orange, magenta, royal blue, lime green, purple with no repeat on neighbours. Geometric sans-serif type, light charcoal descriptions. No hand-drawn lines, no paper texture, no cartoon characters, no photographic realism, no watermarks, no placeholder text. Clean premium business-template 3D.
```

## Best for

- Timelines and milestone roadmaps
- Numbered procedures and onboarding sequences
- Year-by-year histories
